prompt: Vertical 9:16 photo, setting as the attached image: cobbled street between brick warehouses, a steel suspension-bridge tower closing the end, low winter sun, deep shadow. Walking toward camera, rim-lit, a figure in a baggy beige thrift-shop suit, trousers too short, a battered tan fedora over a black balaclava, microphone swinging loose. Behind him banknotes flutter down through the sun shaft; silhouetted passers-by ignore them. The balaclava has no eye, nose or mouth holes, so no skin shows anywhere; a large white ring is stitched round the whole face, and one small red triangle with rounded corners, pointing down, sits high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on both hands; no robot parts. 28mm, hard contrast, expired film grain, no lettering. Thanks.
